about: The land acknowledgement on the new-world title (title-intro.mjs), set like a film's opening card. The title names the panel for screen readers; it is not shown.
title: Before this forest

paragraphs.text: Before this forest, there was land. Before our story, there were peoples who walked it, named its waters, sang its seasons, and cared for its living things. In many places, they walk it still. The names are spoken. The songs go on.

This game took shape upon their homelands: along the coasts, beside the lakes, and in the valleys where its makers live; on the distant ground where its machines hum through the night; and in all the places whose voices taught those machines to speak. Its characters have travelled to us through generations of telling. Its words carry something of innumerable lives: what people loved, what they feared, what they could not bear to forget.

So we pause at the threshold. We honour the first keepers of the lands that have sustained this work, and those who tend them still: the peoples whose names we know, and those whose names we have yet to learn.
Then, quietly, we offer back what we have made: a wooden box, intricately carved, with a forest folded inside.
We leave the lid open. Whoever you are, wherever you have come from, there is a path here for you.
